authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan sources, focusing on underetymologised and smaller sources first for greater diversity. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have unlimited time now

proposals.evidence: Turner4686 carati gives Prakrit carai, Nepali carnu and Maithili/Awadhi carab to graze. Dhakal p44 explicitly labels cər graze.IMP and p54 gives cərike to graze; p75 identifies -ike as INF. These two inflections continue the unextended intransitive stem; the longer caralə record is excluded pending causative analysis.

proposals.evidence: Turner3856 *khasati gives Prakrit khasai, Nepali khasnu, Maithili khasab and Hindi khasna fall/slip. Dhakal p52 contrasts kəsike tighten with kʰəsike fall down, verifying initial aspiration and the unextended khas- stem. The infinitive -ike is documented in p75. No -kk-, -ḍ- or -r- extension is present.
